description:
crates/core/src/env.rs tests use std::env::set_var without a Mutex or serial_test attribute. Under the default parallel test runner, cargo runs all unit tests in the same binary concurrently; test_default_is_production races against test_development/test_dev_shorthand/test_test_variant/test_unknown_is_production because all call set_var/remove_var on the shared STOA_ENV process variable.

Confirmed: 3 failures in 5 consecutive default runs. Single-threaded run (--test-threads=1) passes 7/7.

The code comment in env.rs lines 87-88 acknowledges this hazard and says to use --test-threads=1, but that is not enforced and is not part of the standard quality gate in AGENTS.md. Any CI pipeline running default cargo test will see intermittent failures.

Fix options (in order of preference):
1. Add serial_test crate (or std::sync::Mutex) to serialize the env-var tests.
2. Replace set_var/remove_var with a wrapper that injects the value via a function parameter or a thread-local so the production code path does not need process-global state.
3. At minimum: add a .cargo/config.toml [test] test-threads=1 for this crate so the default invocation is safe.
title: env::tests racy under default parallel runner — intermittent CI failure
